about_the_game:
Set Sail and Live the Life of a True Mariner!

Step into the vast open sea, where adventure, trade, and discovery await. Open Sea Simulator lets you experience the freedom of a sailor’s life—whether you're fishing, shipping cargo, exploring bustling port cities, or simply enjoying a quiet moment on the water with a cup of coffee.

Fishing – From Hobby to Industry

Reel in the catch of the day! Start with simple rod fishing or dive into large-scale industrial fishing with specialized vessels. Upgrade your gear, master different techniques, and sell your haul at local markets to grow your fishing empire.

Transport & Delivery – Build a Maritime Business

Take on shipping contracts, deliver cargo, and optimize your routes for maximum efficiency. Whether it’s a quick package drop-off or a high-risk long-haul journey, every decision counts. Manage fuel, expand your fleet, and ensure on-time deliveries.

Tourism & Charters – Become a Luxury Captain

Turn the sea into your business! Organize scenic cruises, lead whale-watching tours, or offer luxury yacht experiences. Keep passengers happy, upgrade your fleet, and build a reputation as the best tour operator on the water.

A Dynamic World Awaits

Face unpredictable storms, navigate realistic waters, and explore stunning port cities. Will you conquer the seas or be at the mercy of the waves?

Wishlist Now and Set Sail Soon!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 1300X / Intel Core i5 9400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1070 / Radeon RX 5500 XT 6GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 25 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: These system requirements can´t cover all possible system configurations so issues could occur that influence the functionality in some cases.

  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600 / Intel Core i7 10700

short_description: Set sail in this open-world sailing simulation! Take on transport missions, reel in massive catches, manage a thriving tourism business, or race in high-stakes ship competitions. Explore vibrant cities, navigate dynamic weather, and make your mark on the open sea!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Turkish
